name: ATMPIN Management Response V 03
definition: The ATMPINManagementResponse message is sent by an ATM manager or its agent to the ATM to provide the information and the outcome of the cardholder PIN operation requested in the ATMPINManagementRequest.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMPINManagementResponse.name: ATMPIN Management Response
ATMPINManagementResponse.definition: Information related to the response of an ATM PIN Management from an ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
